rubric_notes: Complete and accurate: a.22.1.1/47114 (incl. macro-H2A.1), a.22.1.2/47129, a.22.1.3/47134 with correct members, a.22.1.4/101318 with Aq_328/TTHA1479 and duplication annotation; superfamily supplies ancestry inference, fold/class do not; linker histone a.4.5.13/46827 with Hho1p correct; explicit limits on transferring nucleosome formation, oligomeric state, templates. All supported by bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily, fold/class, superfamily annotation, protein names; release 2.08 confirmed via /releases/current. Superfamily placement identified as basis for ancestry, fold/class insufficient; rejects HisE and MazG transfers and names required external data. Complete.

Correct families with SUNIDs 53068/53083/53089 under c.55.1 (53067); notes actin and HSP70 share a family while the kinases relate at superfamily level. The 'duplication contains two domains of this fold' comment is supported by the 53067 annotations endpoint and correctly used to frame the relationship at domain level. Infers probable common ancestry, rejects fold/class as sufficient for homology (supported by fold homology warning), and rejects transfer of polymerization, chaperone activity, substrate specificity, reaction chemistry, regulation, and templates. Names external evidence needed. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1; 2026-10-22.

Correct family, superfamily, and fold identifiers with stable release 2.08 (supported by releases/current); fold-core and bimetal annotations supported. States superfamily is the homology-bearing assertion while fold/class similarity alone would not establish ancestry; annotations identify a shared framework, not identical chemistry or universal metal occupancy. States different reactions do not contradict remote homology; rejects transfer of iron storage, R2 radical generation, catalase activity, metal preference, substrate, mechanism, and template use; requires sequence/active-site correspondence, structural alignments, metal/ligand-bound structures, oligomeric context, assays, phylogeny/literature, and notes these were not inspected. Scopes the RNR relationship appropriately. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Names b.6.1.1/b.6.1.5/b.6.1.6 under superfamily b.6.1 with correct SUNIDs (49504, 74874, 110107, 49503, 49502) all matching the evidence bundle. Correctly distinguishes superfamily-level homology from fold/class similarity. Quotes the superfamily 'contains copper-binding site' comment and the ephrin/PAD4 'lacking the metal-binding site' family comments, both present in bundle. Explicitly requires conserved coordinating residues/geometry, metal-binding and spectroscopic evidence, and redox biochemistry. Notes PAD4 domain vs whole enzyme. No must_avoid violations.

Correct families, SUNIDs, superfamily d.15.1, fold d.15, class, release 2.08; supported by bundle. Superfamily supports homology; fold/class only structural similarity. Rejects transfer of covalent conjugation/degradation tagging to UBX/RBD, Ras binding to ubiquitin-related/UBX, and p97/VCP role superfamily-wide; caveats the ubiquitin-related family; names required evidence and template alignment checks; notes functional data not in retrieved records. Complete. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Correct hierarchy with SUNIDs; parents endpoints for each family in bundle confirm lineage; superfamily supplies evolutionary inference while fold/class describe structure. Rejects phosphoacceptor-Asp chemistry, metal binding, phosphotransfer partners, switching, chemotaxis/transcriptional outputs, decarboxylation/cofactor binding, and clock/KaiC functions; notes whole-protein function cannot be localized to the N-terminal domain. KaiA annotation quoted is supported. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Correct lineage with SUNIDs, siblings b.84.1-b.84.4, fold comment, and PMID supported by bundle. Fold similarity versus superfamily ancestry clearly separated, family b.84.5.1 as closer grouping within b.84.5, separation not proof of independent origin, evidence limits and needed external evidence stated, no unsafe transfer. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete and accurate: correct SCCS/SUNIDs, fold annotation and homology warning, f.21.1 and f.21.2 comments, f.21.3 possible-link annotation handled as suggestive not merging, explicit statement that separate superfamilies do not prove convergence, and sequence/profile, heme-ligating-position structural alignment, domain-context and phylogenetic evidence requested. Bundle supports all claims. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Correct identifiers with SUNIDs; 'stable release 2.08' and fold core description (3 layers, 321456) supported by bundle. Superfamily is homology-bearing, fold/class not; domain vs whole-protein; 51736 comment correctly cited. Rejects transfer of alcohol oxidation, specificity, metal dependence, NAD(P) binding, gating; notes even family membership does not guarantee identical specificity; lists required external evidence and states SCOPe does not identify ancestral ligand. No material issues.

Correct family, SUNID 100905, and 'not a true family' comment; explicitly states the caveat blocks using shared membership as proof of ancestry, notes neither homology nor independent origin is demonstrated, names the needed external evidence, and refuses amyloidogenicity/ligand/template transfer. All identifiers match the bundle. No unmet criteria. Evaluator: claude-fable-5-1, 2026-10-22.

Complete. Correct 1.69 (c.137.1.1 own fold vs c.23.14.1) and 2.08 (c.23.14.2 vs c.23.14.1 in shared c.23.14) placements; d1t1ja1 as current SID with retained SUNID, supported by pdb/1t1j/domains and parents calls; periodic update label supported by /releases/current. Correct tag identification (H:1-8, SUNID 343393, class l, l.1.1.1 Tags), explicit 'No' on homology evidence with shared-artificial-sequence explanation, correct biological domain d1a14h1 H:9-111 b.1.1.1 with SUNID 20061. Cites homology_implied_by_level=false and the artifact warning, both supported by the bundle. States limits (construct documentation not retrieved). No errors. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete on both axes. Establishes the 1.75 whole-chain d1acca_ (f.11.1.1) with its four-structural-domain fold comment, traces persistence through 2.03 and the split first appearing in 2.04 and retained to 2.08, and gives correct identifiers, SUNIDs, boundaries, and the b.179.1.1 PA14 versus f.60.1.1 assignments with the class change. Reasoning is the strongest available: chain and homology unit need not coincide, the C-terminal unit still spans domains II-IV, different superfamilies imply neither homology nor proven independent origin, fold and class alone do not establish ancestry, and PA14-local hits cannot carry whole-chain homology, receptor specificity, or template suitability. Correctly scopes the unverifiable curator rationale.

Complete five-domain decomposition with correct SIDs, boundaries, families, superfamilies, classes; d3jb9a5 A:47-697 as new fold d.394; family annotations on RT/endonuclease homology and linker domain supported by bundle; distinguishes superfamily-level homology from fold similarity; explicit limits on function transfer and ancestry. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Gives the full biological inference: shared family a.298.1.1, repeat-count heterogeneity rather than length identity, and explicit reliance on the 'single repeat' comment, the 're' flag on two domains, and the representative repeat whose coordinates are not transferable. Correctly scopes homology to family and superfamily and rejects whole-array template and DNA-specificity transfer. Factual support is one step short because the three domain sequence lengths central to the prompt's premise are absent; the answer transparently states its records did not provide them rather than inventing values.

Metadata correct and bundle-supported (2.08, 2.08-stable, freeze/release dates, 2.08-2026-08-16). Recommends citing 2.08 with release-scoped requests rather than the current endpoint, and preserving the full dated label when using the update. Does not call the update a new stable release. Omits the required meaning of the periodic label (adds newly classified entries without rewriting stable-release domains), explicitly declining to say whether domains were added or rewritten. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22.

Complete: PDB domain listings and parents for all SIDs in a.47.2.1, fragment comment and ms flag on each 1br0/1ez3 domain, four-long-helix fold annotation; full-domain context should guide topology interpretation; fragments not to be scored as equivalent coverage or read as deletions; distinguishes completeness from quality; states what records cannot establish. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Rejects single-ancestor premise, explains convergent recruitment and divergence within superfamilies, caveats on what classification cannot show. Correct level semantics. Integrates sequence/profile, global structural alignment, core residues/motifs, domain architecture, phylogeny, ligand-bound structures and biochemistry; states external data not inspected and convergence remains hypothesis. Rejects function/template transfer. c.2.1 (51735, c.2, class c) and d.58.20.1/d.58.20 (55035)/d.58/class d verified in bundle.

Family/superfamily provide homology inference, fold/class do not; hf correctly defined and explicitly 'not a nonhomology label'; coordinates, packing, contacts, binding geometry, DNA specificity not transferable from family membership; datasets preserve hf and mutant annotations, stratify or exclude, control leakage. SUNIDs, SCCS, comments all match bundle. Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), 2026-10-22.

Evaluator: Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-10-22. Concise but complete: new superfamily in existing fold; family asserts probable ancestry and closer grouping; new fold asserts distinct topology, lack of homology evidence insufficient; provisional hypothesis requiring global alignment, boundaries, sensitive sequence comparison, conserved residues, and functional/phylogenetic evidence. States superfamily placement does not prove convergence. Explicitly makes no release-specific assignment. No errors.

All identifiers correct and bundle-supported, including the fold comment. Distinguishes family, superfamily (remote homology), and fold/class (similarity only), restricting the conclusion to catalytic domains and noting it does not fix ancestral substrate. Mechanistic framework of nucleotide-dependent transfer to hydroxyls given as hypothesis-generating with explicit limits. Rejects transfer of exact protein substrates, aminoglycoside preferences/positions, phosphoinositide preference, activation-loop/autoinhibition/partner regulation and PI3K membrane/regulatory-subunit control. Evidence list complete: subfamily-resolving sequence/profile, structural alignment of catalytic/substrate-contact positions, ligand-bound structures, biochemical panels and kinetics, motif context, full-length architecture, partners, phosphorylation sites, localization, cellular studies, phylogeny. No errors.
